spec.description: Share of job runs that failed over a 5m window (failures ÷ total runs), on every queue. Empty when no jobs ran. Counters reset on app restart, so this reflects the current process only.
spec.title: Queue job error rate

spec.description: Log lines per level over time. Level comes from the JSON log line, so it is empty in dev mode (console format).
spec.title: Log volume

spec.expr: sum by (job_type, status) ((queue_job_runs_total{job="wealth-warden", queue="scheduler"} unless queue_job_runs_total{job="wealth-warden", queue="scheduler"} offset 24h) or increase(queue_job_runs_total{job="wealth-warden", queue="scheduler"}[24h]))

spec.description: Shows how many scheduled jobs were triggered during a span of 24h
spec.title: Scheduler job counter

spec.expr: sum by (job_type) ((queue_job_duration_seconds_sum{job="wealth-warden", queue="scheduler"} unless queue_job_duration_seconds_sum{job="wealth-warden", queue="scheduler"} offset 24h) or increase(queue_job_duration_seconds_sum{job="wealth-warden", queue="scheduler"}[24h])) / sum by (job_type) ((queue_job_duration_seconds_count{job="wealth-warden", queue="scheduler"} unless queue_job_duration_seconds_count{job="wealth-warden", queue="scheduler"} offset 24h) or increase(queue_job_duration_seconds_count{job="wealth-warden", queue="scheduler"}[24h]))

spec.description: Shows the average duration of each scheduled job over the last 24h.
spec.title: Scheduler job duration

spec.expr: sum by (job_type, status) ((queue_job_runs_total{job="wealth-warden", queue!="scheduler"} unless queue_job_runs_total{job="wealth-warden", queue!="scheduler"} offset 24h) or increase(queue_job_runs_total{job="wealth-warden", queue!="scheduler"}[24h]))

spec.description: Shows how many times each queued job ran in a span of 24h, on the default and rebuild queues.
spec.title: Queue job count

spec.expr: sum by (job_type) ((queue_job_duration_seconds_sum{job="wealth-warden", queue!="scheduler"} unless queue_job_duration_seconds_sum{job="wealth-warden", queue!="scheduler"} offset 24h) or increase(queue_job_duration_seconds_sum{job="wealth-warden", queue!="scheduler"}[24h])) / sum by (job_type) ((queue_job_duration_seconds_count{job="wealth-warden", queue!="scheduler"} unless queue_job_duration_seconds_count{job="wealth-warden", queue!="scheduler"} offset 24h) or increase(queue_job_duration_seconds_count{job="wealth-warden", queue!="scheduler"}[24h]))

spec.description: Shows the average duration of each queued job over the last 24h, on the default and rebuild queues.
spec.title: Queue job duration

spec.description: Pending alerts wait for their 'for' time. Firing alerts also show in Alerting.
spec.title: Alerts

spec.description: Share of requests that end with a server error.
spec.title: 5xx ratio

spec.description: How long the oldest pending job has waited. Up to 15m is normal: one job can hold a queue for its full timeout. QueueBacklog fires above 30m.
spec.title: Queue lag

spec.expr: sum by (queue, job_type) ((queue_job_runs_total{job="wealth-warden", status="discarded"} unless queue_job_runs_total{job="wealth-warden", status="discarded"} offset 24h) or increase(queue_job_runs_total{job="wealth-warden", status="discarded"}[24h])) > 0

spec.description: Jobs that failed on their last attempt in the last 24h. River will not run them again. No data is the good case.
spec.title: Discarded jobs (24h)
